$comment: Capstone, gate-ON condition: the whole constitution mechanized. Every edit-time hook the series built is registered at once, including the capstone's widened sealing vocabulary, the raw-icon rule and the four MVVM rules (which ride inside the existing seal and shape hooks, because those hooks run the repo eslint config). The responsive gate stays soft, as Part 5 disclosed: it is an instruction in the stage prompts to run npm run check:responsive and fix until it passes, because Playwright needs a whole rendered app and a per-edit hook is physically impossible. strictTemplates is on in both conditions.
